title: Starship EVO
description:
Multiplayer uses a Server / Client framework and requires port forwarding. Please refrain from buying the game for multiplayer for now!

A crash left you stranded on a planet. Mine and craft your way back into space, build your own starship and explore a vast, dangerous galaxy alongside your crew.

 

For players who love a meaningful survival progression, a unique and elegant building system, and epic space-opera scale. 

Craft it. Build it. Fly it. Rule the stars!

Survive And Reach The Stars- Mine and harvest resources, craft better gear, and build a hovercraft to explore the surface.

- Scale up production with an assembler, arc-furnace, and H2 farm. Meet the growing power demands and design an efficient inventory network.

- Build your first spaceship and reach orbit! Explore the starting system to acquire a faster drive and better weapons. Manage fuel and oxygen.

- Defeat the pirates blocking the Stargate. The galaxy is now yours to explore!

Build Anything, from Fighters to Capital Ships- Stretch bricks to the perfect shape and blend grid sizes from 0.125m to 32m to create anything from small starfighters to massive dreadnoughts, mechs to space stations.

- Paint everything and apply decals to make your builds truly personal. Share on the workshop or explore the thousands of creations made by the community.

- Engineer intricate cockpits, landing gear, and turrets using sliders, rotors, hinges, and pistons. Design the perfect interior for you and your crew down to every detail.

- Use systems like artificial gravity, life support, mag-lock, and shipyard. Wire everything together and trigger logic with event gates and sensors.

Make your Mark in a Dangerous Galaxy- Pick your fights: liberate sectors from pirates in the outer rim, or defeat factions for control toward the core. Come prepared!

- Visit space stations to trade goods and take on missions. Build the right ship for the job.

- Be the captain: hire crewmembers from several colorful alien races.

- Fly seamlessly from orbit to surface, explore planets and asteroid rings. Find your own place in the galaxy!
description_short: Mine and craft your way to orbit, build your own starship and explore a vast, dangerous galaxy alongside your crew. For players who love a meaningful survival progression, a unique and elegant building system, and epic space-opera scale.
